about: Analyst synthesis for Urdaibai. Episodes grouped, per function, by the kind of response their reading describes. Not source facts; no scores.

mobilisation.label: Contesting the museum extension
mobilisation.rationale: A platform and residents activate people around opposition to the extension.

mobilisation.label: Convening the territory to contrast perspectives
mobilisation.rationale: The listening process brings institutions, parties, platform and residents — and later the missing voices — around shared profiles.

mobilisation.label: Sustaining shared heritage and celebrations
mobilisation.rationale: Money, volunteer time and institutional commitments are gathered for a boat and a gathering.

knowledge.label: Revising shared profiles of the conflict
knowledge.rationale: Participants test and revise analytical profiles; Ibarrangelu produced a new profile.

knowledge.label: Bringing in missing and outside perspectives
knowledge.rationale: Voices not yet heard — young people, migrants, international experts, an opposition platform — are set against the prevailing reading.

knowledge.label: Transmitting craft knowledge
knowledge.rationale: Volunteers and teachers pass on restoration skills to students; transfer more than recombination.

coordination.label: Aligning roles around heritage work
coordination.rationale: Distinct roles — owner, funder, technical direction, volunteers, businesses — are aligned around one undertaking.

coordination.label: Institutional regulation of shared resources
coordination.rationale: Institutions align access to water and to a heavily visited site; contested by some residents.

coordination.label: Collective tenure
coordination.rationale: Housing use is organised through a cooperative's rules.

support.label: Collectively held housing
support.rationale: The only episode read through mutual support. Institutional provision (water) is not coded as mutual support.
